Compiled the single defined term 'Consolidated EBITDA' from §1.01 plus five terms defined inline within the same definition (Expected Run Rate Benefit; Acquired Entity or Business; Converted Restricted Subsidiary; Sold Entity or Business; Converted Unrestricted Subsidiary).

All 5 frozen-inventory items (start-up/de novo 36-month window; discontinued-ops 12-month window; Expected Run Rate Benefit 36-month condition; facility ramp-up 36/12-month pro forma treatment; and the CRITICAL Letter of Intent Transactions election) are consumed on the specific nodes that carry their value.

Given the sheer breadth of this 'kitchen sink' EBITDA definition (22 sub-clauses in (a) alone, plus (b), (c), (d) and two provisos), narrative/qualitative addback categories not flagged by the frozen inventory and not reducible to a determinate formula were represented as UNSUPPORTED nodes (individually or bucketed) rather than forced into fabricated formulas - consistent with the safety principle that a cautious PARTIAL representation is preferable to a confidently wrong COMPLETE one.

The Section 6.01 cross-reference in clause (a)(xix) remains unresolved (Phase 2's source-context budget was exhausted before it could be expanded); the ambiguous 'paragraph (c)' and 'clause (b)' cross-references in clause (b) were left un-adjudicated per Phase 2's own findings of genuine textual ambiguity.
No WireRule outputs were produced because the supplied text is a pure definitional provision (no independently operative permission/prohibition/ratio-test rule is stated in §1.01 itself).

All 5 frozen-inventory items (start-up/de novo 36-month window; discontinued-ops 12-month window; Expected Run Rate Benefit 36-month condition; facility ramp-up 36/12-month pro forma treatment; and the CRITICAL Letter of Intent Transactions election) are consumed on the specific nodes that carry their value.

Given the sheer breadth of this 'kitchen sink' EBITDA definition (22 sub-clauses in (a) alone, plus (b), (c), (d) and two provisos), narrative/qualitative addback categories not flagged by the frozen inventory and not reducible to a determinate formula were represented as UNSUPPORTED nodes (individually or bucketed) rather than forced into fabricated formulas - consistent with the safety principle that a cautious PARTIAL representation is preferable to a confidently wrong COMPLETE one.

The Section 6.01 cross-reference in clause (a)(xix) remains unresolved (Phase 2's source-context budget was exhausted before it could be expanded); the ambiguous 'paragraph (c)' and 'clause (b)' cross-references in clause (b) were left un-adjudicated per Phase 2's own findings of genuine textual ambiguity.
No WireRule outputs were produced because the supplied text is a pure definitional provision (no independently operative permission/prohibition/ratio-test rule is stated in §1.01 itself).
